WHY ACCEPT IS NOT THE EASY PATH
Three part-states on one task, at once: accepted with undo live, rejected, and still proposed.
Undo on the Tags row is a real control, not a toast that has already gone. It restores no tags in one step.
The rejected Priority row keeps medium and says so. It will not be proposed again.
Summary is untouched and still carries all three actions.
Because Summary is unreviewed the task is still pending, in the rail and in the lists.
